scope: Row-by-row repository artifact/config inventory for the TIME forecasting benchmark; each serialized time-series route is named separately below.
benchmark_card_claim: 50 datasets and 98 forecasting tasks. This release tree contains 50 Arrow routes/configs; processed-CSV tree contains 909 CSVs grouped under those dataset families.
important_license_conflict: The parent benchmark card/API says CC BY-NC 4.0 (explicitly updated 2026-05-25 to satisfy constituent-source terms), whereas the processed-CSV child Hub API says Apache-2.0. The underlying benchmark card states source datasets are assembled; no per-source rights proof has been established here. Treat rights as not cleared for the requested open-use suite until reconciled.
disposition: CROSS OUT all listed task routes from the requested non-gated, open-use benchmark suite pending rights reconciliation. They are publicly accessible and structurally compatible with flattened-window MLP forecasting, but license evidence is conflicting/restrictive; no saturation pilots were run.

datasets.dense_mlp_fit: Numeric time-indexed target route is structurally convertible to fixed-lookback input/forecast regression by sliding-window extraction; exact task windows/splits must be reconstructed and verified before use.
datasets.no_gate_access: Public Hugging Face API/repository; no gate in repository metadata.
datasets.rights_disposition: CROSS OUT: benchmark parent declares CC BY-NC 4.0 because constituent-provider terms require it; processed-CSV child repository separately declares Apache-2.0, so the data-rights relationship is ambiguous and not sufficient to certify unrestricted open reuse.
datasets.difficulty_pilot: Not run: rights gate fails/unresolved before model evaluation.
